median = (lat_sorted[n // 2 - 1] + lat_sorted[n // 2]) / 2 if n % 2 == 0 else lat_sorted[n // 2]
p95 = lat_sorted[int(0.95 * (n - 1))]
print(f'samples: {n}')
print(f'median ms: {median}')
print(f'p95 ms: {p95}')
